role_digest_rule.definition: review_role_sha256 is _harness.hash_files over the ordered review_role_files, including each relative path, NUL separators and file bytes; it is not sha256sum of the single file.

decision_rule: Separate raw numerical reproducibility, scientific validity, claim binding, lifecycle provenance and SSOT consistency. A local numerical pass cannot repair a missing independent claim key, circular oracle, incomplete gate predicate or untrusted lifecycle. Exact contradictions are FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE, never majority-resolved.
